title: THE LOST KIND: Sins of Men
synopsis: After the events in the forest, a man raised by monsters journeys into the human kingdom in search of answers about his forgotten past. With the help of a young royal archivist, he follows a trail of buried secrets that leads him to a terrible truth beneath the capital.
